work.title: Esquiline fresco cycle
work.note: Between 1960 and 1970, he published studies on painting and sculpture, including the Esquiline fresco cycle (1962), the Aldobrandini Wedding (1962), and imitation vs. originality in 3rd-century AD sarcophagi (1970).

work.title: Alexander Mosaic
work.note: His contributions to Neue Forschungen in Pompeji (1974) and a new edition of the Alexander Mosaic (1977) reflect his focus on Roman painting and Late Republican/Early Imperial classicism.

work.title: Odysseus: Archäologie des europäischen Mythos
work.note: On these themes, he published "Odysseus: Archäologie des europäischen Mythos" (1982: https://archive.org/details/laokoonunddiegru0000andr/page/n5/mode/2up ; Italian trans. "L’immagine di Ulisse", Einaudi 1983, trans. Giorgio Bejor), illustrating the mythic-cultural meaning of the Sperlonga group, and "Laokoon und die Gründung Roms" (1988; Italian trans. "Laocoonte e la fondazione di Roma", Il Saggiatore 1989).

work.title: Studien zur roemischen Grabkunst
work.note: In 1962, he completed his habilitation in Bonn with a monograph on Roman funerary art ("Studien zur roemischen Grabkunst"), dedicated to his mentors Friedrich Matz, Reinhard Herbig, and Ernst Langlotz.

work.title: Die antiken Sarkophagreliefs
work.note: Since 1974, he has edited the Roman sarcophagi corpus "Die antiken Sarkophagreliefs", authoring the 1980 volume on hunting scenes ("Die römischen Jagdsarkophage": https://digi.ub.uni-heidelberg.de/diglit/asr1_2 ).
